cc:Work.dc:title: Madrid Metro Map (Treni derivative)
cc:Work.dc:description: Derived from "Madrid Metro Map.svg" by Javitomad and Wikimedia Commons contributors (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Madrid_Metro_Map.svg), used under CC BY-SA 4.0. Javitomad created the source file in 2007 and contributors have revised it since; most of the line shapes here come from a 2022 redraw by Snooze123. Modifications for the Treni app: redrawn/edited line geometry, station layout and styling; internal station identifiers stripped; lines relabeled L1-L12, LR and ML1-ML3.
